w: Reading A placed T3-011, reader B T3-011 and T3-084. 'Let's help them out!' for the UVic mark, 'Will do when I can. Already helping out Canada and canucks' and 'I tried to help earlier, but I think people thought I was vandalizing UVic' send help to another room's work (T3-011, both readers), and lead. 'We are fighting hard for it, can you help us?' and 'We are trying to spruce up the UVic logo on r/place, wondering if SFU wanted to help' ask another room for help (T3-084, reader B and my B1); T3-011's must_not_show sends 'asking for help (T3-084)' there. Two concepts, alone at their level.

Both readers placed T3-011 and T3-004. 'What color do you want the background of SNSD to be above the heart?', 'white with a black border' and 'Can do!' settle the mark's look (T3-004, all three placements). r/bangtan's offer to help integrate, 'We could help you build it' and r/stlouisblues' 'We'd be happy to assist' send help to another room's work (T3-011, both readers). 'Do not overwrite the Blues logo please', r/stlouisblues' 'place your logo somewhere where it doesn't overwrite our blue note logo' and 'i promise youll get a space if we can just work together' settle space with neighbours (T3-010, my B1); the three themes tie at three concepts and are ordered by placements, all inside the cap. My B1's T3-151 has no concept: no return is named.

Both readers placed T3-011. 'we'll send in the cavalry', helping 'a flaggy friend' twice, r/Cambodia's request for a different spot answered 'I'll try looking for somewhere that's kind of open', and help for Maryland's flag send help to other rooms' work (T3-011, both readers). The US flag's 'if y'all aren't too busy with our state flag', 'Help us Build a Huge US Flag', 'Help Defend the American Flag!', 'We may have lost the TX flag ... we can't lose the US flag too!' and Chile's flag saved as 'the false lone star' help a flag felt as kin (T3-078, my B1); the two tie at seven concepts and T3-011 comes first on placements. 'Texas > USA. Get your priorities straight, Yankee.', 'Country first IMO.' and 'Texas first is country first.' weigh the room's flag against the nation's (T3-085, my B1).

Reading A placed T3-011 and T3-072, reader B T3-011. 'We'll help you guys out! We're from SFU', 'Let's give them a hand!', the warning that asks for support, 'I fixed your F', 'We are defending you as valiantly as we can', helping defend r/UBC 'against /r/polandball' and 'I tried to help out all 3 schools' send help to other rooms' work (T3-011, all three placements), and lead. 'aw thanks' and 'It was cool the way the SFU and UBC guys helped out' thank other rooms for help (T3-072, reading A); two concepts, alone at their level. 'We west coast Canadian schools need to stick together!' calls for an alliance (T3-150, my B1); one concept, alone at its level.

Both readers placed T3-011 and T3-151. Proposals to 'help vegan foods expand, such as the Avocado' (twice), 'together we can spread the vegan love', 'vegan love' added by the Avo Army, helping 'our avocado friendos', fixing the avocado, patching Mega Man, helping r/AvoArmy merge with the trans flag and helping it when 'they're being invaded by r/trees' send help to other rooms' work (T3-011, both readers), and lead. '/r/AvoArmy was kind enough to give us that space, I think going over an avo would be a dick move' and the attempt 'to talk to them' (r/CFB) settle space with neighbours (T3-010, my B1); two concepts, alone at their level. 'In return for help defending our sign I have agreed to help keep the cube free from rogue pixels' trades help (T3-151, all three placements); one concept, alone at its level.

q: Help to any other room's work (T3-011); the room's own flag (T3-065).
w: Reading A placed T3-078, reader B T3-011, my B1 T3-078. T3-078's must_not_show sends 'Help to any other room's work' to T3-011; the kinship is carried by the venue and the request, not stated in the words, and no field says how much of it the gate needs.

Content named: 'before Germany invades France', 'the Blitzkrieg', a joke on 'Norwegian sailrs ... suspected of series of rapes', 'Do not let Russia to overtake Slovakia flag' and 'the evil texians'.

q: calls for hands sent to kindred subs (T3-062)
w: Reading A placed T3-013, reader B T3-084, my B1 T3-033. The one concept, 'Come join Devon and Dorset on /r/Place', gathers kindred regional rooms together, which T3-013's must_show names ('a regional place sub for several teams'). T3-013's must_not_show sends 'calls for hands sent to kindred subs' to T3-062, which no reading placed; the invitation asks for no help with a work (T3-084) and proposes no mark (T3-033), and no field says whether an invitation to join kindred neighbours is a hub or a call for hands.

'got the go ahead to take that heart', 'Diplomatic Negotiations were attempted' and applying 'to r/GreenLattice for a portion of thier piece' ask rooms for space they hold (T3-035, all three placements), and lead. 'We must work together and do it quickly, or be swarmed by the purple army of Destiny' calls members in to place (T3-002, reader B and my B1); one concept, alone at its level.

Both readers placed T3-035. r/lotr's 'We don't have to conflict! Would you mind staying off our drawing?' asks a neighbour to refuse an overlap (T3-010, my B1). T3-035 needs 'A request for space or permission addressed to the room that holds it'; r/lotr asks for no space the Lakers hold, only that its own drawing be left alone, which T3-010's must_show names ('overlaps accepted or refused').
